# {{title}}

> [!abstract]+ Summary
> 
> The topic, purpose, and contribution of this source.
> 
> ````markdown
{{"Summarize the supplied source in two concise paragraphs. Identify its topic, apparent content type, purpose, and useful contribution. Attribute important claims to the source. If evidence is sparse or only metadata is available, say so; do not infer video contents from a title."|replace:"/^([>][ ]*)+/gm":""|replace:"/`{4,}/g":"```"|replace:"/^/gm":"> "}}
> ````

---

>

>

{{url|replace:"/^/gm":"> "}}

{{schema:@VideoObject:duration|replace:"/^/gm":"> "}}

{{meta:property:og:image|replace:"/^/gm":"> "}}

> ````

---

> [!note]+ Key points and explanations
> 
> Source-supported points with interpretation clearly identified.
> 
> ````markdown
{{"Extract up to five source-supported key points. Explain each briefly and include any source-provided steps, definitions, or technical details needed to understand it. Distinguish observations from interpretation. Return Markdown bullets only."|replace:"/^([>][ ]*)+/gm":""|replace:"/`{4,}/g":"```"|replace:"/^/gm":"> "}}
> ````

---

> [!question]+ Keywords and research ideas
> 
> Search queries and questions are suggestions, not observed rankings.
> 
> ````markdown
{{"Return three labeled groups: Keywords extracted from the source, Suggested search queries, and Suggested questions to investigate. Limit each group to five items. Search queries and questions are unverified suggestions, not Google or YouTube rankings, search results, or measured popularity."|replace:"/^([>][ ]*)+/gm":""|replace:"/`{4,}/g":"```"|replace:"/^/gm":"> "}}
> ````

---

> [!warning]+ Uncertainties and missing evidence
> 
> Limits, conflicts, and assumptions requiring review.
> 
> ````markdown
{{"List missing evidence, contradictions in authors or dates, possible extraction limits, and assumptions that matter. Compare supplied text with metadata when possible. Do not invent conflicts. If none are apparent, state that none were identified within the supplied evidence. Do not claim completeness."|replace:"/^([>][ ]*)+/gm":""|replace:"/`{4,}/g":"```"|replace:"/^/gm":"> "}}
> ````

---

> [!example]+ Project and agent brief
> 
> A proposed project brief to copy into a later agent session.
> 
> ````markdown
{{"Propose one practical project grounded in the source. Label it as a proposed idea. Return a copyable brief with these headings: Goal, Source evidence, MVP scope, Requirements, Acceptance criteria, Open questions, and Agent instructions. Tell a later agent to verify assumptions and prepare an OpenSpec-style proposal and task list before implementation. Do not claim to have run OpenSpec, researched competitors, or created project files. Use plain note-name candidates only, never invented wikilinks."|replace:"/^([>][ ]*)+/gm":""|replace:"/`{4,}/g":"```"|replace:"/^/gm":"> "}}
> ````

---

> [!todo]+ Follow-up actions
> 
> Interactive tasks remain outside code fences.
> 
{{"Return up to four concise follow-up actions as unchecked Markdown task lines beginning - [ ]. Label source-prescribed actions and suggested actions distinctly. Do not add introductory text, headings, code fences, or callout syntax. Do not claim any task is complete."|replace:"/^([>][ ]*)+/gm":""|replace:"/`{4,}/g":"```"|replace:"/^/gm":"> "}}
